query: I have a 77-year-old man to evaluate: among male Medicare patients aged 72–82 who were transferred from another hospital and had unstable angina as the principal diagnosis at admission with discharge recorded, how many total admissions met these criteria?
final_sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT adm.hadm_id) AS total_admissions
FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` AS adm
INNER JOIN
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` AS p
    ON adm.subject_id = p.subject_id
INNER JOIN
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` AS dx
    ON adm.hadm_id = dx.hadm_id
WHERE
    -- Patient criteria
    p.gender = 'M'
    AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM adm.admittime) - p.anchor_year + p.anchor_age) BETWEEN 72 AND 82

    -- Admission criteria
    AND adm.insurance = 'Medicare'
    AND adm.admission_location = 'TRANSFER FROM HOSPITAL'
    AND adm.dischtime IS NOT NULL

    -- Principal diagnosis criteria for Unstable Angina (ICD-9 and ICD-10)
    AND dx.seq_num = 1
    AND dx.icd_code IN ('4111', 'I20.0');
